jobs.title: Nestlogic ADP
jobs.description: Nestlogic ADP â Nestlogic Nestlogic About Portfolio Careers In-house tool, used on customer engagements Nestlogic ADP. Nestlogic ADP is the analytics and deployment platform we built for our own engineers, and now use on customer engagements to move data and AI workloads from prototype to production. What it does ADP packages the practices we kept re-implementing on every project: ingestion, pipeline orchestration, model training and serving, monitoring, and the small operational pieces that turn a working notebook into a dependable service. It is not a product we sell off the shelf. It is a platform we operate with the customer, sized to their workload and shaped by their constraints. Where it fits Data pipelines at scale Batch and streaming ingestion, transformations, and storage patterns we have run on AWS, on GCP, and on customer-owned hardware. Machine learning in production Training pipelines, model registries, serving infrastructure, and the monitoring needed to catch drift before it matters. Applied AI products The adjacent work that turns a model into a feature users rely on: APIs, back-office tools, and the loops that keep the model improving. Talk to us If you're thinking about a data or AI system you want to run in production, write to info@nestlogic.com and we will take it from there. © 2026 Nestlogic Inc.
